question_text:
Implement a Cloud Infrastructure as Code or Cloud SDK automation utility for **Challenge #03: Cloud Storage, Databases & Lifecycle Policies**.

### Problem Specification:
- Write an automated script in Python (Boto3) or declarative HCL parsing module.
- Validate cloud resource tags, manage lifecycle transitions, or audit unattached volumes.
- Handle API pagination and retry with exponential backoff on `ThrottlingException`.
answer_explanation: Evaluates cloud resource tagging compliance, audit automation, and safe resource lifecycle management in Cloud Storage, Databases & Lifecycle Policies.

criteria.name: Functional Correctness
criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.
